# Validation and Release

## Principles

Validation proceeds from affected tests to package checks to repository-wide
release checks. Paid providers, remote mutations, generated production media,
and publishing are excluded. Tests use mocks, deterministic fixtures, and
mutation seams.

Do not rerun unchanged failures. Follow the test-command and repair limits in
`AGENTS.md` during each implementation batch. The broad commands below are final
release gates explicitly authorized by the repository-refactor request, not the
default for ordinary batches.

## Per-Batch Gate

For every batch:

1. record worktree status and affected files;
2. run the directly affected test file;
3. repair/retry within the bounded budget;
4. run at most one affected-package typecheck after focused tests pass;
5. run targeted lint or syntax/doc checks;
6. inspect the diff for unrelated changes and secrets;
7. update reports with exact commands, results, risks, and follow-up.

Fixtures change only for an approved intentional contract change. Semantic
assertions are preferred over broad snapshots.

## Deterministic Test Matrix

| Area | Required scenarios |
| --- | --- |
| registry/DAG | duplicate IDs, cycles, missing/optional dependencies, profile applicability, stable order |
| artifacts | canonical/legacy resolution, conflicts, containment, checksums, schemas, atomic promotion, migration rollback |
| state/events | every transition, rebuild, corrupt state, overrides, approvals, stale revisions, interruption, reconciliation |
| cache/invalidation | hits/misses, each fingerprint input, missing/corrupt output, explicit and dependency invalidation |
| batches | partial failure, successful-item preservation, retry, resume, cancel, rate limit, grouping, costs |
| CLI | parsing, help, examples, JSON, dry-run, exits, aliases, actionable errors, shell completion generation |
| Dark Truth | bibles, references, replacement invalidation, story/Short/localization quality, continuity, media QA |
| mathematics | curriculum, prerequisites, symbolic verification, answers, visuals, pedagogy, accessibility, localization |
| providers | mock request mapping, retry classification, redaction; live tests opt-in only |
| AI pack | deterministic build, hashes, sources/symbols, links, size, binary and secret rejection |

## Release Commands

After focused batches pass, inspect current scripts/config before running:

```bash
pnpm build
pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint
pnpm test:unit
pnpm test:integration
pnpm test:e2e
pnpm test:cli-packaged
pnpm ai-pack:build
pnpm ai-pack:validate
pnpm ai-pack:status
```

Run docs diagram checks if changed. Run reliable duplicate-writer, stale-import,
legacy-command, and artifact-path searches from the final audit register. Do not
run provider credentials, YouTube upload, remote render mutation, or production
media generation.

## Baseline Comparison

The final report compares results to the baseline in
`00-baseline-and-audit-gate.md`. A failure may be accepted only when evidence
shows it existed before the refactor, its relevant files were not changed, it is
not exposed or worsened by the new architecture, and the operator explicitly
accepts it. Introduced regressions block release.

## Compatibility Acceptance

- representative existing Dark Truth episodes resolve canonical and legacy
  scripts/artifacts without silent conflicts;
- representative mathematics lesson workspaces import valid lineage;
- legacy commands delegate and preserve documented JSON, exit, and side effects;
- migration dry-run is write-free and rollback manifests validate;
- no active caller imports removed application implementations;
- no production command writes artifacts outside the repository abstraction.

## Completion Criteria

Release is accepted only when:

- the audit covers the full repository;
- each logical task has one canonical application implementation;
- every active entry point delegates through the registry/engine;
- obsolete logic is removed or listed as a temporary adapter with a removal
  condition;
- paths, state, events, cache, invalidation, batching, resume, reconciliation,
  approvals, and observability meet their contracts;
- Dark Truth bible/reference/quality policy and mathematics
  curriculum/correctness/visual/pedagogy/accessibility policy are enforced;
- existing artifact layouts remain readable;
- deterministic validation and AI-pack freshness pass, except explicitly
  accepted unchanged failures;
- remaining technical debt and anything not verified are documented;
- reports confirm that no paid provider request or publishing operation ran.

## Final Report Contents

The final implementation report records inspected areas, baseline and
pre-existing failures, duplicate inventory, canonical selections, removals,
retained adapters, package boundaries, CLI, state/events, cache/batch/recovery,
both profile integrations, all changed paths, tests/results, AI-pack structure
and manifest coverage, unresolved debt, unverified behavior, and the explicit
no-provider/no-publish confirmation.
